description.zh: 指定要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The endpoint of the host that you want to query. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh: 指定要查询的主机名称。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the host that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户所在堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the hosts that the user is authorized or not authorized to manage.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机列表的模式。取值：
- **Authorized**：已授权（默认）
- **Unauthorized**：未授权
description.en:
Specifies the category of the hosts that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Authorized**: queries the hosts that the user is authorized to manage. This is the default value.

- **Unauthorized**: queries the hosts that the user is not authorized to manage.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机的操作系统类型。取值：
- **Linux**
- **Windows**
description.en:
The operating system of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1。
description.en: The number of the page. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
指定要的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the hosts that the user is authorized or not authorized to manage.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUsers](~~204522~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user.

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the ID of the user.

title.zh: 查询指定用户已授权或未授权的主机列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-hosts-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode Authorized --user-id 1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --host-address 192.168.XX.XX --host-name abc --os-type Linux --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListHostsForUser --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber 1 --UserId 1 --OSType Linux --Mode Authorized --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --HostName abc
